question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Keep your head
solution:
The correct answer is **'​****Remain calm'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'Keep your head'** is **'Remain calm' or **continue doing something quietly. (Keep one's self control)
 
• **Keep your head**: to stay calm. (शांत रहना)
 
 
• *Example: 1) She **kept her head **under pressure and went on to win the race.*
 
• *2) To remain calm She has shown that she can keep her head in a crisis*.

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Remain calm.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__*** language experts believe the phrase comes from the military,** where commanding officers would use it as a way to tell troops to stay alert to a pending danger on the battlefield.**
